title: AMS Lead
description:
AMS Product Lead / AMS Transformation Lead


Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced AMS Product Lead to define, implement, and scale an intelligent, automation-led Application Management Services product for enterprise applications. The role will own the end-to-end AMS product vision, service transformation roadmap, operating model, governance, and delivery outcomes, while driving improved service reliability, faster incident resolution, proactive operations, and enterprise-wide visibility through observability, AI/ML, and automation capabilities.


Key Responsibilities

  • Define and drive the overall AMS product vision, goals, value proposition, roadmap, governance model, and release strategy aligned to business and IT objectives.
  • Gather, shape, and prioritize end-to-end functional and operational requirements for the AMS product and translate them into scalable service capabilities and measurable outcomes.
  • Design and implement an interactive AMS Control Center and unified operating model to improve service visibility, decision-making, and stakeholder experience.
  • Integrate the AMS platform with the broader enterprise application landscape, monitoring systems, ITSM platforms, and workflow tools to enable seamless data flow and operational transparency.
  • Lead intelligent incident management initiatives including AI-driven ticket categorization, automated routing, alert correlation, and operational workflows to reduce MTTR and improve response quality.
  • Implement observability-led support processes using tools such as Splunk, Datadog, Dynatrace, and AppDynamics to enable real-time monitoring, proactive issue identification, and service performance improvement.
  • Drive automation and predictive operations through self-healing workflows, runbook automation, predictive analytics, and reduced manual intervention across support and service management processes.
  • Establish and manage SLA, KPI, service quality, reporting, and performance review frameworks to ensure operational excellence and continuous improvement.
  • Define the AMS support model, optimize resource allocation, improve utilization, identify skill gaps, and build capability development plans for distributed support teams.
  • Introduce agile support practices, structured governance forums, and continuous improvement mechanisms to strengthen service delivery effectiveness and responsiveness.
  • Build enterprise-level executive dashboards and holistic AMS reporting covering incidents, trends, risks, costs, capacity, productivity, and support performance.
  • Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, delivery teams, architecture teams, vendors, and leadership to ensure successful adoption, scale, and continuous evolution of the AMS product.

Required Skills

  • Strong experience in Application Management Services, enterprise application support, or managed services transformation.
  • Deep understanding of AMS operating models, service delivery constructs, and ITIL-based processes.
  • Experience in incident management, service request management, problem resolution, change coordination, and release planning.
  • Strong exposure to observability and monitoring platforms such as Splunk, Datadog, Dynatrace, or AppDynamics.
  • Experience with AI/ML-led service management use cases such as ticket categorization, clustering, routing, correlation, or predictive operations.
  • Knowledge of workflow automation, runbook automation, RPA, and self-healing support models.
  • Experience with ITSM and work management tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, or similar platforms.
  • Strong capability in stakeholder management, executive communication, and cross-functional leadership.
  • Proven ability to manage distributed or global support teams and drive service quality improvements.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, governance, and performance management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to ERP or large enterprise platforms such as Oracle, SAP, or other business-critical application ecosystems.
  • ITIL, Agile, Scrum, or service management certifications.
  • Experience in AIOps, predictive analytics, or intelligent operations transformation initiatives.
  • Experience building reusable assets, accelerators, and automation frameworks in AMS environments

Experience

  • 810 years of overall experience in enterprise application support, AMS, managed services, or service transformation roles.
  • 2-3 years in a leadership role managing AMS delivery, support transformation, product/service governance, or global support operations.
  • Demonstrated experience in leading large-scale AMS transformation initiatives, stakeholder-facing delivery, and service improvement programs.

Education

  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Masters degree is an advantage.

Commercial & Partnerships

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to drive things forward with little direction

title: cloud security engineer
description:
What is CRED?

CRED is an exclusive community for India’s most trustworthy and CREDitworthy individuals, where the members are rewarded for good financial behavior. CRED was born out of a need to bring back the focus on a long lost virtue, one of trust, the idea being to create a community centered around this virtue. a community that constantly strives to become more virtuous in this regard till they finally scale their behavior to create a utopia where being trustworthy is the norm and not the exception. to build a community like this requires a community of its own; a community special in its own way, working towards making this vision come true

here’s a thought experiment: what do you get when you put a group of incredibly passionate and driven people and entrust them with the complete freedom to chase down their goals in a completely uninhibited manner? answer: you get something close to what we have at CRED; CRED just has it better

what you will do:

  • work across a diverse information security domain, with a strong focus on cloud, infrastructure, and data security
  • identify security issues (internal and external), work with stakeholders on mitigation, and design/implement solutions for complex security problems in aws-based systems
  • own and continuously improve the cloud security posture management (cspm) program aligned with standards like nist 800-53 and iso 27001
  • own the cloud workload protection program, including alert investigation and triage
  • drive the data security charter, including data classification, masking, and securing large-scale data stores
  • automate infrastructure security and build security tooling to reduce manual effort
  • conduct security design, infrastructure, and architecture reviews
  • build, operate, and maintain cloud security platforms to enhance prevention, detection, and response
  • translate product requirements into threat models and identify security risks
  • build in-house security frameworks to strengthen security culture across tech teams
  • enable compliance across teams (pci dss, iso 27001, dpdpa) and promote best practices
  • drive security awareness and engineering maturity across the organisation

you should apply if you have:

  • 2–6 years of experience in information security Solid fundamentals on computer networks, operating systems (linux), containers and secure cloud architecture
  • strong programming skills in python, go, or bash
  • solid understanding of cloud security with hands-on experience in aws / gcp / azure
  • experience building and automating custom security tools
  • understanding of microservices, ci/cd pipelines, containers, and securing containerised workloads
  • strong grasp of core security principles like least privilege, defence-in-depth, and zero trust
  • a data-driven mindset with the ability to influence stakeholders
  • security projects on github or technical blogs
  • strong communication skills and the ability to be a go-to security partner for engineers and product teams
  • a proactive approach to staying updated on security threats, breaches, tools, and research
  • basic understanding of llms, mcp, and ai agents and Interest in building ai-driven security workflows.
  • familiarity with vulnerability management, patching cycles, and cvss
how is life at CRED?
working at CRED would instantly make you realize one thing: you are working with the best talent around you, not just in the role you occupy but everywhere you go. talk to someone around you; most likely you will be talking to a singer, stand-up comic, artist, writer, an athlete, or maybe a magician. at CRED, people always have talent up their sleeves. with the right company, even conversations can be rejuvenating. at CRED, we guarantee a good company.
hard truths: pushing oneself comes with the role, and we realize pushing oneself is hard work. which is why CRED is in the continuous process of building an environment that helps the team rejuvenate, including but not limited to a stacked, in-house pantry, with lunch and dinner provided for all the team members, paid sick leaves, and comprehensive health insurance.
to make things smoother and to make sure you spend time and energy only on the most important things, CRED strives to make every process transparent: there are no work timings because we do not believe in archaic methods of calculating productivity; your work should speak for you. there are no job designations because you will be expected to hold down roles that cannot be described in one word. since trust is a major virtue in the community we have built, we make it a point to highlight it in the community behind CRED: all our employees get their salaries before their joining date. a show of trust that speaks volumes because of the skin in the game.
there are many more such eccentricities that make CRED what it is, but that’s for one to discover. If you feel at home reading this, get in touch.

title: Senior Software Engineer II - Storage
description:
Position Overview:

We are looking for an engineer who will help lead the development and support of current and future storage platforms at scale, with a particular focus on Network File System (NFS) and scalable file storage solutions.
The Storage Team supports the operations and development of block volumes, backups, image management, object storage, and scalable file systems like NFS. Our goal is to create a cohesive, singular interface to hypervisor storage, where storage class placement decisions are transparent to the hypervisor client and leverage the full range of block and file storage classes to best satisfy customer needs.

The selected candidate will have the opportunity to make impactful contributions to key software, contribute to the open source community, and debug interesting problems at cloud scale.

What Youll Do:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable NFS solutions and distributed file systems.
  • Support the creation and operations of distributed systems at scale.
  • Program in Go and other languages to develop high-performance storage solutions.
  • Collaborate with a motivated team of peers to architect, develop, and optimize storage services.
  • Contribute to and consume from free/open-source software communities, particularly in the file storage space.
  • Solve complex, large-scale problems in a technically rewarding environment.

Key Metrics:

  • Service availability (SLO/SLA): Monthly uptime for control plane and data plane (e.g., control plane 99.9%, data plane 99.95%); reported monthly.
  • Mean time to detect / recover (MTTD / MTTR): Median detection and recovery times for Sev-1/Sev-2 incidents; tracked per quarter.
  • Incident volume & change-failure rate: Number of incidents by severity and percentage of releases that cause rollbacks or incidents; tracked per release and monthly.
  • Customer adoption & usage growth: Growth in active NFS customers, number of active mounts/clients, and total provisioned capacity (GiB/TiB) measured QoQ.
  • Operational efficiency / automation: Reduction in manual ops (on-call time, manual runbooks, toil) measured as % decrease in operational tickets or hours.
  • Feature delivery: % of planned milestones delivered on time and meeting acceptance criteria.

What You’ll Add to DigitalOcean:

  • Deep knowledge of NFS, scalable file systems, and distributed storage architectures.
  • Experience designing, deploying, and operating highly available file storage solutions.
  • Familiarity with Object Storage and distributed File Systems and how to scale those solutions.
  • Expertise in concurrency/parallelism models in modern programming languages like Go.
  • A passion for open-source contributions and collaborating with the storage community.

*This job is located in Bengaluru, India

Mission

Key missions of the position:

  • Drive end-to-end fulfillment operations ensuring high supplier performance, material availability, and production continuity.
  • Own and improve On-Time Delivery (OTD), On-Time Performance (OTP), and inventory efficiency aligned with business targets.

C (Cost):

title: Python Developer - FastAPI / Flask (Product Engineering)
description:
About PplSync

PplSync is a bootstrapped HRMS product built for Indian SMEs of 50 to 500 employees - face recognition attendance, shift and overtime payroll, and live tracking for field staff. Around 50 companies and 1,500+ employees run on the platform today. Small team, real users, and every release goes straight into production use.


Role and responsibilities

You will own backend services end to end - design, build, ship, and then live with what you shipped. This is not a ticket queue. You will be in the room when we decide what to build, and on the call when something breaks at 9am on salary day.


What you will work on

- REST APIs in FastAPI and Flask that the web platform and the mobile app run on

- Attendance and payroll processing: shifts, overtime, regularisation, multi-branch rules

- Background jobs, scheduled processing, and integrations with third party systems and devices

- Query and performance work as the data grows

- Tests, code review, and owning your own deployments alongside the DevOps lead


Preferred candidate profile

- 2 to 4 years of hands-on Python, in a product company

- Production experience with FastAPI and Flask, not tutorials or side projects

- Solid SQL, schema design and migrations

- Someone who can say what they built, what they decided, and what broke afterwards


Who this role is not for

We are not hiring from an IT services, consulting or staffing background for this position. If your experience is client projects billed to an external customer, this will not be a fit - not because that work is easier, but because this role needs someone used to owning a product with real users and living with the consequences of their own decisions.


Location and working days

Work from office at Koramangala, Bengaluru. Monday to Friday, with alternate Saturdays working.


Compensation

Rs 7,00,000 to Rs 10,00,000 per year, depending on what you have actually built.

We are seeking a strong Applied AI Engineer profile with hands-on experience in modern GenAI and Agentic AI frameworks, capable of contributing immediately to development, delivery, and support of enterprise AI solutions.

title: Security Analyst
description:
Job Description:

We are looking for a skilled Security Analyst with strong hands-on experience in Application Security, Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT), and API Security.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for identifying, assessing, validating, and reporting security vulnerabilities across web applications, APIs, and infrastructure. The role requires strong practical knowledge of security testing methodologies and the ability to work closely with development and infrastructure teams to drive effective remediation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) across web applications, APIs, mobile applications, and infrastructure.
  • Conduct manual and automated security testing to identify vulnerabilities and security weaknesses.
  • Perform Web Application Security testing covering authentication, authorization, session management, input validation, access control, business logic, and common OWASP vulnerabilities.
  • Perform API Security testing, including authentication/authorization, BOLA/IDOR, JWT, rate limiting, HTTP methods, and business logic vulnerabilities.
  • Conduct reconnaissance and enumeration to identify application attack surfaces, endpoints, parameters, APIs, and exposed services.
  • Use security testing tools such as Burp Suite, Nmap, Postman, Nessus, Qualys, and other relevant security tools.
  • Manually validate vulnerabilities identified through automated scanning and assess their actual exploitability and impact.
  • Identify and analyze vulnerabilities such as SQL Injection, XSS, IDOR/Broken Access Control, authentication issues, security misconfigurations, and other application security risks.
  • Prepare detailed security assessment reports including vulnerability description, evidence, severity, impact, and remediation recommendations.
  • Collaborate with development, DevOps, and infrastructure teams to explain security findings and support remediation.

title: Partner Development Representative
description:
Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. We ship AWS modernization to production in weeks, data platforms migrated, legacy applications and databases refactored, AI agents running against real data, for mid-market and lower-enterprise companies in financial services, healthcare and life sciences, internet and software, manufacturing, and TMEGS.

Our delivery model is built around AI agents that absorb the repetitive 60–70% of engagement work, discovery, schema mapping, validation, test generation, cutover rehearsal, that traditional consulting bills against human hours. Forward-deployed engineers work on top of those agents, embedded with the customer's team, owning architecture, judgment, and cutover. We commit to a fixed delivery date on a fixed fee. If we slip for reasons inside our control, the cost sits with us.

Most modernization doesn't ship. Ours does. That is the entire pitch.

You'll be the named Mactores contact for AWS sales teams across US territories. AWS account managers, ISMs, partner-development managers, and specialist sellers each carry a partner deck full of firms that all say roughly the same thing. Your job is to make them see Mactores as the agent-native firm in that mix, the one they route to when their customer needs a modernization program finished, not staffed.

What you'll sell maps directly to what AWS reps care about: we're MAP-eligible, AWS Agentic AI Specialized, and predictable on fixed-date engagements. Our founders built the agent platform we deploy, so deployment depth is a structural advantage and AWS reps make money when we win. The conversation starts on the same side of the table.

You won't run deep technical demos, a forward-deployed engineer does that. You set up the meeting, frame the customer's problem, walk through the agent-native approach in business terms, anchor everything in shipped case studies, and hand off to the FDE when the conversation reaches architecture. Then you close the loop: register the opportunity, keep the AWS rep informed, push the deal forward.

This is not a script-and-cadence PDR seat. AWS reps see hundreds of partner BDRs. The ones who get traction can hold a real conversation about the customer's modernization problem, not run through a sequence.

What you will do?

  • Build coverage across AWS US sales territories: account managers, ISMs, partner-development managers, and specialist sellers (Data, AI/ML, Modernization).
  • Reach out, follow up, show up at AWS Summits and regional partner events, and build named relationships.
  • Walk AWS reps through what agent-native AWS modernization means in practice and why it's different from what every other partner in their deck says.
  • Anchor every conversation in shipped Mactores case studies: named customer, named baseline, named outcome, time-to-value, cost reduction.
  • Identify customer fit, frame the business problem, articulate Mactores' business value, and tee up the technical demo.
  • Hand off to the forward-deployed engineer for the architecture walkthrough. Your job is to make sure the FDE walks into a qualified room.
  • Source Amazon-originated opportunities into the Mactores pipeline, register them in ACE, and keep the AWS rep in the loop through cycle close.
  • Feed market signal back to Mactores leadership, what AWS reps hear from customers, where the partner conversation is shifting, and which messaging lands.

What are we looking for?

  • 3–5 years in a BDR, SDR, or partner-development role, with a demonstrated ability to source qualified pipeline from a cold start.
  • Comfort talking to AWS field teams. Prior work at an AWS partner, exposure to AWS Partner Central, ACE, or MAP, and time on the floor at AWS Summits or re:Invent are preferred, not required but they shorten the ramp.
  • Comfort with the technical concepts of cloud modernization, data platforms, and agentic AI without being the engineer in the room. You can read an architecture diagram, talk through a case study, and name where the customer's pain is. You don't need to debug a Lambda.
  • Sharp business-value articulation: you can take a messy customer problem statement, restate it in two sentences, and show how Mactores ships against it.
  • A self-managed work style. Remote role, distributed AWS field, no daily stand-up babysitting your activity.
  • Travel roughly 30% across the US AWS offices, customer sites, AWS Summits, re:Invent, and regional partner events.

How we work?

We're not selling a roadmap. Our agents run in production today, and our forward-deployed engineers ship with them every day. Mactores is MAP-eligible, AWS Agentic AI Specialized, and holds seven AWS Consulting Competencies and seventeen Service Validations, the credentials that make an AWS rep's routing decision easy.

The agent-native category window is 6–12 months. After that, "agent-native" becomes commodity vocabulary the way "cloud-native" did. We're on the early side of that window, and the BDR who plants the flag in AWS field conversations now will own those relationships when the category gets loud. You'll join an existing partnership and sales motion, the system works. Your job is to add territory coverage and AWS-originated pipeline to it, not invent the function from scratch.

How you'll be measured

A combination of net-new logos and AWS-originated revenue. Not call counts, not email volume, not meetings booked for their own sake. The leading indicator is qualified AWS-sourced pipeline. The lagging indicator is closed-won revenue from customers who came in through the AWS field. Quota structure and targets are discussed in the interview process.

title: SQL Database Developer
description:
Project Overview

We currently maintain our operational data across multiple sources, including APIs, CSV files, and Google Sheets. We want to consolidate this data into a single, reliable SQL-based RDBMS to improve performance, scalability, data integrity, security, and integration with our existing applications and reporting tools.
We are looking for an experienced database engineer to assess our current data, design the database, migrate our historical data, and set up ongoing ingestion so new data keeps flowing in from all sources.

Scope of Work

1. Data Source Assessment

Analyze all current data sources (APIs, CSV files, and Google Sheets), including structure, columns, data types, relationships, formulas, update frequency, and dependencies.

Identify duplicate records, missing values, inconsistent formats, and other data-quality issues.

Document the business logic and workflows that depend on each source.

2. Database Design

Recommend a suitable SQL platform (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, or Google Cloud SQL).

Design a unified schema with tables, primary and foreign keys, constraints, indexes, and relationships.

Create staging tables for each source and normalized final tables.

Track data lineage with source-system and import-timestamp fields.

3. Data Migration and Ingestion

Migrate historical data from all sources into the new database.

Preserve existing records, relationships, data types, and business rules.

Build repeatable, scheduled pipelines for ongoing API pulls and CSV imports.

Handle deduplication and records that appear in more than one source.

Validate record counts and data accuracy after migration.

Implement backup and rollback plans to prevent data loss.

4. Application Integration

Update existing applications, Google Apps Script projects, APIs, dashboards, and reports to use the new database.

Replace direct Google Sheets and file-based read/write operations with database queries or API-based access where applicable.

Ensure existing workflows continue to work after migration.

5. Security and Performance

Configure database users, roles, permissions, and secure connections.

Optimize queries and indexes.

Set up backup, recovery, and monitoring procedures.

6. Testing and Documentation

Perform data validation, integration testing, and user acceptance testing.

Document the schema, migration steps, ingestion pipelines, connection configuration, and maintenance procedures.

Provide support during deployment and post-migration troubleshooting.

Required Skills

Strong SQL and relational database design experience.

Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Microsoft SQL Server.

Experience migrating data from Google Sheets, CSV files, and APIs into SQL databases.

Experience building ETL/ELT pipelines (Python preferred).

Knowledge of the Google Sheets API and Google Apps Script.

Experience integrating databases with APIs and existing applications.

Understanding of data validation, indexing, query optimization, and database security.

Experience with cloud databases such as Google Cloud SQL is preferred.

Deliverables

Recommended database platform and architecture.

Properly designed and normalized SQL schema.

Complete migration of all existing data from APIs, CSV files, and Google Sheets.

Automated ingestion pipelines for ongoing data updates.

Updated application integrations and workflows.

Data validation and migration testing report.

Database documentation, plus backup and rollback procedures.

Goal

Migrate and consolidate our data into a scalable, secure, and reliable SQL database with minimal downtime and no data loss, while keeping existing business operations running without disruption.Role & responsibilities



Preferred candidate profile



We are looking for an experienced Database Migration Specialist with strong SQL and RDBMS knowledge. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in database design, data migration, and integration of data from APIs, CSV files, and Google Sheets into SQL databases.

Required Skills:

  • Strong SQL and relational database design skills.
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Microsoft SQL Server.
  • Experience in data migration and ETL/ELT pipelines.
  • Knowledge of Python, Google Sheets API, and Google Apps Script.
  • Experience integrating databases with APIs and applications.
  • Knowledge of data validation, query optimization, indexing, database security, backup, and recovery.
  • Experience with cloud databases such as Google Cloud SQL will be preferred.

Candidates should have strong problem-solving skills and the ability to complete database migration with minimal downtime and no data loss.

title: Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Backend Software Engineer to join the Treasury Ledger team.

Every time money moves at Wise, Treasury needs to know where it is and in which currency. Our team builds the ledger that answers that question: a real-time, accurate view of Wise's FX position and liquidity.

This is high-volume, event-driven infrastructure where correctness matters. Your work directly supports how Treasury manages Wise's money, and the evolution of the ledger as the business grows.

What will you be working on?

  • Build new specialised ledgers that track Wise's FX risk and liquidity in real time, using modern stream-processing technology.

  • Design real-time reconciliation and data-quality controls that catch discrepancies as they happen, not days later.

  • Bring new Wise products into the ledger as they launch around the world, giving Treasury a complete picture of money moving across products and currencies.

  • Scale the real-time event processing at the heart of Treasury, keeping it fast, resilient and observable as Wise grows.

Technical responsibilities

  • Own features end-to-end, from the product events Wise's systems produce to the real-time ledger streams Treasury relies on, working alongside experienced engineers.

  • Help shape the architecture of new ledgers through design discussions and code reviews.

  • Solve hard distributed-systems problems at scale: exactly-once processing, event ordering, replay and real-time aggregation.

  • Build with a modern stack: Java 25, Spring Boot, Apache Kafka, Apache Flink, MariaDB and ClickHouse.

  • Use AI tooling across the development lifecycle to move faster without compromising quality.

What do you need?

We are fully aware that it is uncommon for a candidate to have all skills required and we fully support everyone in learning new skills with us. So if you have some of those listed below and are eager to learn more we do want to hear from you!

Technical excellence

  • Solid software engineering fundamentals and experience building backend software professionally.

  • Experience with Java or a similar object-oriented programming language.

  • Good understanding of databases and SQL.

  • Care for data correctness and attention to edge cases.

  • Writing well-tested, maintainable code.

  • Willingness to learn new technologies and domains.

Ownership and product mindset

  • Ownership of your work from design through production.

  • Understanding why something is being built and what problem it solves.

  • Curiosity about how FX, liquidity and accounting work.

  • Willingness to take part in incident resolution and post-incident learning.

  • Participation in on-call support for your area when needed.

Influence and collaboration

  • Communicate clearly with engineers, analysts and business stakeholders.

  • Ask questions, share knowledge, and give and receive feedback openly.

  • Contribute to engineering communities or guilds across Wise.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Kafka, Flink or other stream-processing technologies.

  • Experience with analytical databases such as ClickHouse.

  • Experience with event-driven or data-intensive systems.

  • Interest or experience in payments, banking, accounting or another financial domain.

title: Technical Product Manager - Delivery & Availability Management (DAM)
description:
📍 Location: Flexible (UK)

🧩 Remit: Delivery & availability systems, monolith to domain-driven architecture, AI-native product work

🎯 Focus: Shape what our customers can buy, when it arrives and how it gets there, and untangle the monolith behind it.

About Product at Bloom & Wild 🌸

We're Europe's largest direct-to-consumer flower and gifting business (Bloom & Wild, bloomon and Bergamotte), now growing into cakes, candles and hampers. Our 16-strong Product team works in 8 squads, with fortnightly sprints and quarterly OKRs, across London, Amsterdam and fully remote. The Delivery & Availability (DAM) squad sits behind every order: it shapes what customers can buy, when it arrives and how it gets there.

The Role

You'll own the roadmap for our delivery and availability systems and guide a squad of 6 alongside a technical lead. Much of this lives in a large monolith that has grown with the business, and you'll help us untangle it: setting clear domain boundaries and making sure every change lands safely, especially around Christmas and Mother's Day. You'll work with Operations, Commercial and Logistics, and use AI to move faster.

Key Responsibilities

  • Roadmap Ownership: Own the DAM roadmap, balancing a cleaner domain-driven architecture with commercial value along the way.

  • Monolith Untangling: Choose what to change and when, so every release lands safely for customers, warehouse and logistics teams.

  • Range & Carrier Growth: Launch new carriers and more complex product categories with Operations, Commercial and Logistics.

  • Data & AI: Shape clean data models and interfaces that enable automation and agentic commerce, using AI tools (including MCP-based tooling) for research, debugging and analysis.

  • Outcomes: Own squad KPIs, measure impact, course-correct and keep senior stakeholders informed.

What We're Looking For

  • Roadmap Experience: You’ve owned a product roadmap end-to-end as a Technical Product Owner or Manager.

  • Monolith Experience: You’ve worked inside a large monolith to set domain boundaries, bounded contexts or service extractions.

  • Cross-Functional Working: At your best working with Operations, Commercial, Logistics and engineering to solve ambiguous problems.

  • AI & Data Curiosity: Hands-on with AI tools, and you love turning data into decisions.

Don't check every box? Please apply anyway! We hire for potential and diverse perspectives over exhaustive checklists.

Perks & Benefits

  • ✨ Flexibility: Core hours, flexible working, plus up to 45 days a year to work abroad.

  • 🌴 Time Off: 25 days holiday + birthday + flexible bank holidays (option to buy 5 extra days) + a volunteering day.

  • 🌱 Growth & Wellbeing: Equity options, health cash plan, Classpass, Bloom & Learn training framework, enhanced family leave and generous product discounts.

How We Hire

  1. Initial chat with Chloe, our TA Manager
  2. Video call interview with our Head of Product (for Ops Tech)
  3. A longer format interview split into two: one section with some of our engineers and the other section with others from product
  4. 30-minute final conversation with our CPTO
Need interview adjustments? Tell us in your application - we are more than happy to support you however we can.

title: Senior Platform Engineer (AWS)
description:
Hi, we’re PEXA!
We know you’ll Google us before applying, so let’s keep this brief. PEXA revolutionised the way that property is settled in Australia, turning a paper-based process into a digital one. Our solution is a world-first, with over 500 people across Australia and an expanding international team, we’re helping 20,000+ families into their homes each week.
We’re passionate about solving problems for our customers – always striving to set the standard for how property is bought and sold. Being awarded as one of the best places to work in Australia is a recognition of our culture and commitment to innovation, customers and our community.
We’re growing fast, that is where you come in.
We believe our success in Australia is worth sharing and that our proven technology will advance how the UK buys and sells homes.
Establishing ourselves within the UK in late 2020, we are committed to collaborating with lawyers, conveyancers, lenders, government and the property industry, to set the new standard for both remortgages and buying and selling property.

We’re looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our PEXA Go team. You’ll help build and operate the AWS platform behind PEXA Go, making sure it is reliable, secure and well supported as the service develops.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You’ll work closely with the Principal and Lead Platform Engineers to deliver platform priorities, improve the way infrastructure is deployed and operated, and help resolve issues when they arise. You’ll also work with software engineering, Technology Operations, Product, Security and Risk colleagues, so clear communication and good collaboration will matter just as much as your technical experience.

The role includes paid on-call support, responding to alerts and incidents as part of agreed arrangements.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Building, configuring and maintaining the AWS infrastructure and platform services used by PEXA Go.
  • Implementing infrastructure changes through code and automation, helping make delivery repeatable and dependable.
  • Delivering upgrades, technical remediation and lifecycle work, while identifying dependencies and risks early.
  • Improving monitoring, logging and alerting so teams can spot issues and understand what is happening across the platform.
  • Investigating platform incidents and service problems, helping restore service and prevent the same issues from recurring.
  • Making safe, documented changes to live services and contributing technical evidence and follow-up actions to incident reviews.
  • Applying agreed security controls and engineering standards to infrastructure, access, configuration and platform changes.
  • Keeping colleagues informed about progress, risks and technical options.
  • Sharing what you know and looking for practical ways to make the platform and its day-to-day operation better.

What You'll Bring

  • Hands-on experience engineering and operating production workloads on AWS.
  • Practical experience using infrastructure as code, scripting and automation to deliver platform changes.
  • Experience working with containerised applications and Kubernetes, including troubleshooting operational issues.
  • Experience setting up or using monitoring, logging and alerting to diagnose production problems.
  • Confidence investigating incidents and making safe, well-documented changes to live services.
  • A sound understanding of cloud security, networking, resilience, backup and recovery.
  • The ability to work effectively with software engineers and explain technical risks and options clearly.

You’ll take ownership of your work and follow issues through to resolution. When services are under pressure, you’ll bring sound judgement, keep others informed and escalate risks promptly. You’ll also be someone who enjoys working with others and sharing knowledge across the team.

Why Join Us?

You’ll have the chance to work on the platform behind PEXA Go and make a practical contribution to how it is built, supported and improved. You’ll be part of a collaborative engineering environment where platform work connects closely with software delivery, product priorities and the experience of our customers.

If you enjoy hands-on AWS engineering and improving the reliability of live services, we’d love to hear from you.

Why become a PEXArian?

Great question! Being a PEXArian is so much more than just a job. We’re a passionate, motivated and unashamedly enthusiastic bunch at PEXA – we love what we do and we’re proud to admit it! Creating brilliant experiences for our members and their clients wouldn’t be possible without ensuring we deliver an exceptional employee experience.
Here’s a snapshot of what your life at PEXA could look like:

Your wellbeing:

Enjoy four Wellness Days across the year to rest and recharge, plus 24/7 personal safety, medical and mental health support through Sonder. You’ll also receive an £800 Health Flex Pot to spend on health options, alongside access to a digital GP, mental health and nutrition consultations, and support with eye tests and glasses.

Your growth:

Grow your skills and shape your career through PEXA Academy and LinkedIn Learning. You’ll also have up to five days’ paid study leave each year for relevant courses.

Your rewards:

Our reward and recognition benefits include performance-based incentives, the PEXA OwnIt Equity Plan for eligible employees, PEXA Impact Awards and a £500 employee referral bonus. You’ll also have access to discounts through Perkbox and Get Active.

Your family:

Eligible permanent employees with at least 12 months’ continuous service can receive up to 20 weeks’ paid maternity or adoption leave and up to four weeks’ paid paternity leave, in addition to statutory entitlements. You’ll also have access to support for family and life events, including family grief counselling, discounted legal services and UK-registered veterinary advice.

Your work/life blend:

We know that work is just one aspect of your life – we want to help you create your ideal work/life blend, rather than squeezing in life around work. Our hybrid approach combines regular in-office connection with working from home. You may also be able to work remotely from an approved country for up to two weeks every six months and purchase up to four additional weeks of annual leave each year.

Your opportunity to give back:

Use your paid Volunteer Day to support a cause that matters to you and enjoy events throughout the year that bring PEXArians together to connect and celebrate.

Sounds like you?
We at PEXA are ready so if this role sounds like you apply today.

description:
What is your role?

As a Business Analyst E-commerce at Lely, you will be a vital link between business needs and technical implementation. You play a key role in optimizing and innovating the digital customer experience on our E-commerce platforms. By mapping processes, gathering requirements, and analyzing user journeys, you ensure that our digital solutions truly add value for our customers. You will collaborate across departments from UX designers and developers to product owners and business stakeholders ensuring that our platforms support seamless customer interaction and drive commercial success. Do you thrive in dynamic, cross-functional environments and get energized by translating abstract ideas into concrete results? Then we’d love to meet you.

Your key responsibilities include:

  • Collaborating with Product Owners, Developers, and Business Stakeholders to define business needs and translate them into clear, actionable requirements.
  • Mapping and analyzing current and future business processes and digital user journeys.
  • Creating user stories, use cases, and acceptance criteria that guide development in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Leading workshops and interviews to understand strategic business goals and user needs.
  • Supporting sprint planning, backlog grooming, and ensuring alignment between business objectives and technical execution.
  • Identifying opportunities for innovation and process improvement within E-commerce and digital platforms.

We are looking for someone with:

  • At least 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, preferably within E-commerce or digital product teams. Who Leads initiatives, mentors others, makes strategic technical decisions, often bridges business and tech.
  • You bring a proven track record in backend development with a strong emphasis on system integrations
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and tools such as Jira and Confluence and Target process.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage diverse stakeholders.
  • A critical thinker with problem-solving abilities and a proactive mindset.
  • Experience in project and resource management, focused on continuous improvement.
  • A high level of trust, professionalism, and interpersonal sensitivity.
  • Fluency in English; Dutch is a plus.

Working at Lely means contributing to sustainable progress within one of the most innovative organizations in the Netherlands. You contribute to making the agricultural sector future-proof - and we make sure that you get all the space, resources and support you need to do so.

  • An international working environment with opportunities for own initiative and entrepreneurship.
  • Excellent working conditions, including up to 8 weeks of vacation per year and a good pension scheme.
  • A salary within the scale of € 4,201 - € 6,001 gross per month, in which we like to see opportunities for growth from your starting salary towards the future
  • Good growth opportunities: you are in control of your development and can choose from various training courses through our Lely Academy - from personal development to job-specific training.
  • Our modern Lely Campus offers daily access to extensive sports facilities: an indoor gym, outdoor padel courts, an outdoor basketball and volleyball court, table tennis and table soccer. You can join Hyrox workouts or sign up for personal training - and challenge your colleagues during an active break.

  • A free shuttle bus will take you to and from the metro in Maassluis, so your workday starts and ends smoothly.

Recruitment & selection agency, consultancy, and/or secondment agency?

title: Network Engineer
description:
Roles and Responsibilities Network Engineer

Primary Responsibility: Support the customer’s day-to-day network operations, troubleshoot network issues, coordinate incident resolution and assist with technical presales activities.

  1. Network Operations Support
    Support and maintain the customer’s network infrastructure, including switches, routers, wireless access points and related equipment, within the assigned scope.
  2. Troubleshooting and Incident Resolution
    Diagnose and resolve LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, IP addressing, VLAN, routing, uplink and connectivity issues. Identify root causes and recommend corrective measures to prevent recurrence.
  3. Customer Coordination
    Coordinate with the customer’s IT team to understand issues, obtain necessary access and approvals, communicate progress and confirm service restoration.
  4. Monitoring and Performance Review
    Monitor device availability, link utilisation, interface errors and network performance using available tools. Identify potential faults and escalate them before they cause service disruption.
  5. Ticket Management and SLA Compliance
    Log, track and update service tickets. Prioritise incidents according to business impact and work towards the applicable response and resolution timelines.
  6. Configuration and Change Management
    Configure network equipment and implement approved changes. Maintain configuration backups and rollback plans, and perform changes in authorised maintenance windows.
  7. Installation and Commissioning
    Support equipment installation, firmware updates where supported, configuration, connectivity testing and commissioning. Verify functionality before handing over to the customer.
  8. OEM, ISP and Vendor Coordination
    Coordinate with OEM support teams, internet service providers and other vendors for technical escalation, circuit faults, hardware failures and RMA processing, wherever applicable.
  9. Preventive Maintenance
    Conduct scheduled health checks covering device status, logs, power supplies, fans, temperature, port errors and uplink connectivity. Submit findings and recommendations.
  10. Standby and Replacement Support
    Assist with spare verification, standby deployment, configuration restoration and testing of replacement devices. Record equipment movement, serial numbers and customer acknowledgement.
  11. Pre-AMC Device Verification
    Inspect switches before AMC commencement, collect available logs and record their operational condition. Identify dead or faulty devices and report them for finalisation of the AMC inventory.
  12. Network Security Support
    Follow the customer’s security policies, protect credentials and configuration files, and implement approved access controls and security settings. Escalate vulnerabilities and unsupported equipment risks.
  13. Documentation and Reporting
    Maintain network diagrams, IP address records, port mappings, device inventories, configuration records and incident reports. Prepare service updates and root-cause analysis reports as required.
  14. Presales and Site Surveys
    Participate in customer discussions and site surveys to assess requirements, existing infrastructure, cable routes, equipment locations and technical constraints.
  15. Solution Design and Proposal Support
    Assist in preparing network designs, BOQs/BOMs, technical specifications, compliance sheets, implementation plans and technical proposals. Coordinate with OEMs for product selection and sizing.
  16. Demonstrations and Proof of Concept
    Support product demonstrations and POCs, conduct agreed tests, document results and assist in addressing customer technical queries.
  17. Service Improvement and Capacity Planning
    Recommend improvements to network availability, performance and capacity. Highlight ageing equipment, lifecycle limitations and future expansion requirements.
  18. Teamwork and Professional Conduct
    Coordinate with internal teams, maintain proper handovers, attend assigned customer visits and follow site procedures. Maintain confidentiality and provide clear, professional communication.

title: Frontend Engineer Lead
description:
We are hiring a Lead Frontend Engineer with 10+ years of experience to own frontend architecture, performance, real-time communication, and UI systems at scale. This role is for an engineer who understands not only how to build UIs but also why certain styling, state, and library choices scale better over time.

The core responsibilities for the job include the following:

Frontend Architecture / System Design:

  • Design scalable, maintainable frontend architectures for complex web applications.
  • Define application structure, module boundaries, and shared component strategies.
  • Drive decisions around: Rendering models (SSR, SSG, ISR, CSR), Styling architecture, and State and data flow.
  • Apply architectural patterns such as: Component-driven architecture, Feature/domain-based organization, and Micro-frontend patterns (when justified).
  • Maintain architecture documentation, diagrams, and ADRs.

Frontend Engineering (Hands-on):

  • Build and maintain production-grade applications using Next.js (3+ years) and modern React.
  • Write clean, maintainable TypeScript.
  • Design and evolve reusable component libraries and design systems.
  • Lead code reviews focusing on architecture, performance, and long-term maintainability styling / UI Architecture.
  • Design and enforce scalable styling strategies using a mix of: CSS Modules, Styled-components / Emotion, Utility-first CSS (Tailwind or similar), Traditional CSS / SCSS where appropriate.
  • Make informed trade-offs between: Runtime vs build-time styling, Global vs scoped styles, and Design system tokens vs local overrides.
  • Build and maintain: Theming systems, Responsive and adaptive layouts, Cross-browser and cross-device compatibility.
  • Ensure styling consistency and avoid CSS leakage and specificity issues.

State Management:

  • Architect complex state systems with clear separation of concerns: Server state vs. client state vs. UI state.
  • Manage real-time and shared state across views and sessions.
  • Prevent unnecessary re-renders and state coupling.

Real-Time Communication:

  • Build real-time features using WebSockets, Server-Sent Events (SSE), and WebRTC (where applicable).
  • Design client-side subscription models, reconnection logic, and data consistency strategies.
  • Coordinate real-time data flow with backend services and message brokers.

Performance Engineering:

  • Own frontend performance strategy across the stack: Code splitting and dynamic imports, Bundle size analysis and optimization, Rendering optimization and memoization, Virtualization for large lists.
  • Optimize Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP).
  • Use performance tooling (Lighthouse, Web Vitals, browser profilers).

Security and Reliability:

  • Implement frontend security best practices: XSS, CSRF, clickjacking mitigation, Secure auth flows (OAuth2 JWT, session-based), and Safe handling of tokens and secrets.
  • Understand browser security, CORS, and content security policies (CSP).
  • Ensure safe usage of third-party libraries and SDKs Libraries, Tooling Ecosystem.
  • Expertise in build and tooling ecosystems: Webpack, Vite, Turbopack, Babel, ESLint, and Prettier.

About the Role:
The Senior Facility Executive will be responsible for managing day-to-day facility operations, housekeeping, cafeteria and pantry services, vendor management, general administration, inventory control, and workplace upkeep. The role requires strong operational ownership, effective team coordination, proactive monitoring of service standards, timely closure of complaints, and ensuring a clean, safe, hygienic, and well-maintained workplace

Responsibilities

1. Facility Operations & Administration

· Manage day-to-day facility operations and general administrative activities.

· Monitor staff attendance and allocate daily tasks to shift supervisors.

· Coordinate with shift executives to prepare duty rosters and share them with the reporting manager.

· Conduct regular inspections of the front office, lobby, work areas, and restrooms to maintain high standards of housekeeping and upkeep.

· Ensure newspapers and magazines are available and appropriately placed in the front office.

· Plan and monitor weekend activities and ensure timely completion of assigned tasks.

· Prepare daily snag reports, track pending issues, and coordinate with internal teams for closure.

· Conduct regular facility inspections and verify that completed work meets the required standards.

· Ensure the workplace remains clean, organized, safe, and operationally ready.

2. Housekeeping, Pantry & Cafeteria Management

· Oversee housekeeping, cleaning, pest control, pantry, and cafeteria operations to ensure hygiene, cleanliness, and service quality.

· Monitor housekeeping staff deployment, attendance, grooming, and work quality.

· Ensure regular cleaning and upkeep of men's and women's restrooms, common areas, and cafeteria spaces.

· Ensure bedspreads are sent for washing monthly and maintain appropriate records.

· Monitor cafeteria operations, food quality, freshness, presentation, and timely service during designated meal periods.

· Coordinate with cafeteria vendors to ensure adequate food availability, quality, hygiene, and adherence to agreed service standards.

· Conduct regular and surprise inspections of the cafeteria, dining areas, serving counters, and other food service areas.

· Collect employee feedback, address cafeteria-related complaints, and coordinate corrective actions with vendors.

· Monitor food consumption, wastage, and service efficiency and identify opportunities for improvement.

· Check pantry and housekeeping consumable stock levels, verify reorder requirements, and inform the reporting manager to initiate replenishment.

· Prepare and submit pantry and housekeeping consumption reports.

· Check vending machines and water coolers daily and coordinate with internal technicians to resolve faults.

· Ensure cafeteria equipment, refrigerators, water dispensers, and other appliances are maintained in good working condition.

3. Complaint, Snag & Escalation Management

· Review pending complaints and action items, prioritize issues, and drive timely closure.

· Coordinate with internal support teams and external vendors to resolve facility-related issues.

· Maintain complaint trackers and daily snag reports, ensuring clear ownership and closure timelines.

· Proactively identify operational challenges and keep managers informed of issues requiring escalation.

· Track recurring complaints and coordinate corrective actions to prevent recurrence.

· Follow up with relevant stakeholders to ensure service requests are resolved within agreed timelines.

4. Vendor & Service Management

· Coordinate with vendors providing housekeeping, cafeteria, pantry, pest control, and other facility-related services.

· Monitor vendor attendance, manpower deployment, performance, and service delivery against agreed standards.

· Verify the quality and completion of vendor work before confirming closure.

· Conduct periodic and surprise inspections to ensure compliance with service standards.

· Coordinate with internal technicians and relevant teams to resolve equipment faults and maintenance issues.

· Review cafeteria and other facility vendor invoices against agreed commercial terms, services delivered, and supporting documents.

· Maintain vendor performance records and escalate recurring service deficiencies.

5. Inventory, Procurement & Cost Control

· Monitor housekeeping, pantry, and cafeteria consumables and maintain adequate stock levels.

· Track consumption, verify reorder levels, and coordinate procurement approvals with the reporting manager.

· Maintain accurate stock registers, consumption reports, and supporting documentation.

· Monitor food consumption and wastage and support cost-control initiatives.

· Ensure materials and consumables are used efficiently and replenished on time.

6. General Administration & Documentation

· Organize, maintain, and coordinate administrative functions and departmental records.

· Handle filing, documentation, and maintenance of facility-related reports.

· Coordinate outdoor activities, liaison work, and follow-ups with external agencies and business stakeholders.

· Review and process vendor bills, ensuring supporting documents and service completion details are verified.

· Take ownership of pending follow-ups and coordinate with relevant stakeholders for timely resolution.

· Prepare operational updates and reports for senior management and the reporting manager.

· Maintain duty rosters, attendance records, inspection checklists, complaint trackers, and vendor documentation.

7. Workplace Readiness & Flexibility

· Ensure smooth day-to-day operations and operational readiness of the workplace.

· Support planned facility activities, audits, inspections, and special events as assigned.

· Be available to support after-hours or weekend building-related activities when required.

· Take initiative in identifying improvement opportunities and resolving operational challenges.

· Ensure compliance with organizational policies, safety requirements, hygiene standards, and established SOPs.

Skills

·Excellent interpersonal, verbal communication, and customer service skills.

· Strong organizational, coordination, and time-management abilities.

· Ability to lead, motivate, and coordinate shift supervisors and housekeeping teams.

· Strong vendor management and service quality monitoring skills.

· Good problem-solving, ownership, follow-up, and escalation management capabilities.

· Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel, for reporting and operational tracking.

· Attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively

Experience and Qualifications

· Graduate degree or equivalent qualification preferred.

· Relevant experience in facilities management, workplace operations, or general administration.

· Experience managing housekeeping, cafeteria, pantry operations, vendors, inventory, and facility maintenance.

· Prior experience coordinating shift teams, monitoring service standards, and handling operational escalations.

Equal Opportunity

Zeta is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds, cultures, and communities to apply and believe that a diverse workforce is key to our success

title: Cyberark Engineer
description:
Requirements:

Role: CyberArk Engineer-L2
Location: Mumbai
Qualification: Any Graduate
Experience: 3-8 YEARS

Role Overview
The CyberArk L2 Implementation & BAU Operations Engineer is responsible for managing the daily operations, support, and maintenance of the CyberArk Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform. This role ensures the secure handling of privileged accounts, timely resolution of operational issues, efficient onboarding processes, and adherence to compliance and audit requirements. The engineer acts as the second-level technical contact for CyberArk-related issues and collaborates with cross-functional teams to maintain a robust PAM environment.

Key Responsibilities
CyberArk Implementation & Configuration

  • Design, install, configure, and deploy CyberArk PAM solutions (PAS, PSM, PSMSession, PTA).
  • Implement CyberArk Vault (EPV), CPM, PSM, PSM for SSH, and PSM for Web.
  • Perform onboarding of privileged accounts for Windows, Unix/Linux, Databases, Network devices, and Applications.
  • Configure password policies, platforms, safes, dual control, and access workflows.
  • Integrate CyberArk with Active Directory, LDAP, and SIEM tools (Splunk, QRadar, etc.).

Daily Operations & Monitoring

  • Monitor the CyberArk Vault, PVWA, CPM, PSM, PSMP and PTA components and ensure system health.
  • Review password rotation jobs, platform tasks, and CPM activity status.
  • Analyze logs and alerts to identify potential issues and security risks.

Incident & Problem Management

  • Provide L2 support for CyberArk-related incidents raised through ticketing systems.
  • Troubleshoot issues involving password rotation failures, CPM errors, PSM access problems, and platform connectivity.
  • Hands on experience on DR drill.
  • Perform root cause analysis for recurring issues and implement corrective actions.
  • Escalate unresolved or critical issues to L3 or vendor support.

Privileged Account Lifecycle Management

  • Onboard privileged accounts across Windows, UNIX, databases, network devices, and applications.
  • Configure safes, access control policies, platform settings, and rotation schedules.
  • Ensure timely password changes, reconciliations, and compliance with organizational security policies.


Access Management & User Support

  • Manage user access provisioning/de-provisioning for CyberArk users, groups, and safes.
  • Support end-users for credential checkout, PSM session access, and workflow approvals.
  • Conduct periodic access reviews and ensure least-privilege compliance.

System Maintenance & Housekeeping

  • Perform regular health checks and cleanup activities across CyberArk components.
  • Monitor storage, logs, backup status, and session recording utilization.
  • Update CyberArk platform configurations and apply policy modifications as required.

Compliance, Reporting & Audit Support

  • Generate operational, audit, and compliance reports on schedule.
  • Support internal and external audit activities.
  • Ensure CyberArk configuration aligns with security and regulatory standards.

Integration & Enhancement Support

  • Support integration of new applications, systems, and domains with CyberArk.
  • Configure and troubleshoot CPM/PSM plugins and platform-specific settings.
  • Collaborate with IAM, DevOps, and application teams for automation/API use cases.

Security Monitoring & Incident Response

  • Review PTA alerts, PSM session logs, and privileged activity anomalies.
  • Assist SOC and IR teams during security investigations involving privileged accounts.
  • Report suspicious behavior and ensure timely resolution.

Documentation & Knowledge Management

  • Maintain up-to-date SOPs, runbooks, architectural diagrams, and operational guides.
  • Prepare troubleshooting documentation for repeated issues.
  • Provide knowledge transfer and mentoring for L1 teams.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with CyberArk components (Vault, PVWA, CPM, PSM, PTA).
  • Hands on experience on DR drill.
  • Strong understanding of PAM concepts and privileged account security.
  • Experience troubleshooting CPM/PSM issues and account onboarding.
  • Knowledge of Windows, Linux, network devices, and database authentication.
  • Familiarity with ticketing tools (ServiceNow, JIRA, etc.).
  • Basic understanding of scripting/automation (PowerShell, Python added advantage).
  • Handon experience on Cp or CCP

description:
Senior Business Technology Manager

Location: Mohali (Chandigarh Tricity), Punjab, India |

On-site | Full-time Schedule: U.S. Pacific business hours (night shift, India time)


About the role:


You will own the technology that runs a group of fast-growing U.S. home-services and solar brands: Elevation Energy Solutions, Grid Association, and Chief Electric. You start with a small team (one full-stack developer and one virtual assistant) and build it into a 68 person technology team over the next 1224 months. You will build the systems, the middleware, the phone stack, the data layer, and the team — from the ground up. This is a player-coach role. You write code, read code, build reports, wire integrations, document systems, and map processes yourself, while managing the people who do the same. You move fast, you communicate clearly, and you ship. Your first 6–8 months center on one thing: becoming the company's ServiceTitan expert. Learn it end to end, build it out for Chief Electric, document every workflow, build the reporting, fix what breaks, and use AI to run it faster. After that, the job widens into everything below. What you will own 1. ServiceTitan (primary focus, months 1–8) • Own ServiceTitan setup, configuration, and go-live for Chief Electric. • Build and document every workflow: call booking, dispatch, pricebook, memberships, invoicing, payments, marketing attribution, reporting. • Build the reporting layer: dashboards for sales, ops, marketing, and finance. Pull the numbers leadership needs weekly. • Own integrations in and out of ServiceTitan (phone, CRM, marketing, accounting, dialer). • Be the internal expert: train staff, write SOPs, fix issues, manage the vendor relationship. 2. Atlas, custom software, and middleware • Own the roadmap for Atlas, the company's internally built operating system (CRM and operations platform). • Design and build the company middleware: the integration layer that connects ServiceTitan, Atlas, the dialer, phone system, marketing platforms, and accounting into one flow of data. • Manage the full-stack developer: set priorities, review code, run sprints, ship on schedule. • Scope, staff, and deliver new builds as they come: dialers, mobile apps, integrations, internal tools, automations. • Set up testing and release processes so nothing goes live broken. Build a QA function as the team grows. • Build with AI tools every week (Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, Replit, Lovable, or similar). 3. Voice, telephony, and communications • Own the company phone and messaging stack: VoIP, SMS, call routing, call recording, IVR, and number management. • Build and manage on programmable telephony platforms such as Twilio, Telnyx, or similar; connect them to the CRM, the dialer, and ServiceTitan. • Bring call, text, and lead data into one place so every conversation is tracked and reportable. 4. Software stack and security • Own every software tool the company pays for: who uses it, what it costs, how it connects, when to replace it. • Manage user access, roles, and permissions across all three brands. • Set and enforce baseline cybersecurity: MFA, access reviews, offboarding, data handling, backups. • Manage vendor contracts, renewals, and software spend. 5. Process, data, and documentation • Map new business processes with department heads and turn them into systems and flows. • Own company documentation: SOPs, system maps, data dictionaries, runbooks. • Tie marketing, inbound, and outbound lead flows into the CRM and reporting so every lead is tracked from first touch to sale. • Plan and build the company data layer: a central reporting database / data lake fed by ServiceTitan, Atlas, the dialer, telephony, marketing platforms, and accounting. 6. Team • Manage the full-stack developer and VA today. Hire and lead a team of 6–8 (developers, QA, systems/integration, data) as the company grows. • Set weekly targets, run standups, review work, and hold the team to a high output standard. • Train the team on AI-assisted development and documentation. Requirements (all of these are required) • 7+ years in software development, systems implementation, or business systems, with 2+ years leading a small team. • You write and read code. Comfortable in at least one modern stack (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, SQL, or similar) and able to review a developer's pull request. Candidates who cannot code will not be considered. • You build with AI tools daily. Working experience with several of: Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, Replit, Lovable, GitHub Copilot, or similar. You stay current on what's new and apply it to system building, documentation, and reporting. • You have implemented or administered a field service management or CRM platform (ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, FieldEdge, Jobber, Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, or similar). • You have built or managed integrations and middleware between business systems: APIs, webhooks, and either middleware tools (Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom services. • You understand VoIP and programmable telephony. Hands-on with Twilio, Telnyx, or a comparable platform: numbers, routing, SMS, recording, and connecting them to a CRM or dialer. • You are business-savvy. You understand the KPIs a home-services company runs on (cost per lead, booking rate, close rate, average ticket, revenue per tech, CAC) and can build reporting around them. • Strong SQL and reporting skills. You have built dashboards and pulled operational reports from live business systems. • You have written technical documentation and process flows that non-technical staff could follow. • You have managed a team and pushed it to deliver. Hands-on every day; you know exactly what your team is working on. • You move quickly, communicate clearly in writing and on calls, and finish what you start. • Fluent written and spoken English. Able to work full U.S. Pacific hours. Strongly preferred • Hands-on ServiceTitan experience (admin, implementation, or reporting). If you have this, say so first. • Experience inside a home-services company (electrical, HVAC, plumbing, solar, roofing, garage doors) or a company that sells to them. • Experience with call-center or outbound sales operations: dialers, lead routing, CRM workflows, inbound/outbound pipelines. • Has connected marketing platforms (Google Ads, Meta, Google Business Profile, call tracking) into a CRM for attribution. • Has built or contributed to a data warehouse or data lake (BigQuery, Snowflake, Postgres, Redshift) with a BI tool on top (Looker, Power BI, Metabase, Tableau). Nice to have • Service design background: mapping customer and employee journeys and redesigning the process before building the system. • Cybersecurity or IT administration experience (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365 admin, identity and access management). • Mobile app development experience. • Experience managing offshore or distributed teams. How success is measured • ServiceTitan live for Chief Electric on schedule, with documented workflows and working reports. • Atlas roadmap and middleware shipped on time; defects caught in testing, not in production. • Phone, text, and lead data flowing into one tracked, reportable system. • Every software tool has an owner, a cost, and a documented purpose. Access is clean across all brands. • Team hired, trained, and delivering at a high standard. Who you are A builder who can also lead. High energy, fast-moving, and hands-on. You would rather learn a system inside out than delegate it. You document as you go. You use AI to move faster than anyone around you. You are easy to work with and clear when you communicate. You want to join a company early, build the technology function from the ground up, and grow a large team under you
